+def apply_refund(charge, amount, reason=None):
+    if charge["status"] != "succeeded":
+        raise ValueError("only a succeeded charge can be refunded")
+    if amount > charge["amount"]:
+        raise ValueError("refund exceeds the original charge")
+    remaining = charge["amount"] - amount
+    return {
+        "refunded": amount,
+        "remaining": remaining,
+        "status": "refunded" if remaining == 0 else "partially_refunded",
+        "reason": reason,
+    }
